goal-ambiguity.derivation: Finite-bank scalar minimax: two noise balls meet iff distance<=2 sigma; half their largest goal gap is the exact finite-bank risk.
goal-ambiguity.ceiling: Supplied finite bank; lower bound on any containing operational class.
goal-ambiguity.reopen: Matched unseen command/history goal gaps or an observation/noise-model change.

finite-radius.derivation: ker(DP|K) subset ker(DG|K) implies linear factorization and a rank lower bound; Lipschitz recovery needed for the nonlinear lower bound. Full-direction bound carries E, B DO and all three remainders.
finite-radius.ceiling: Numerical tangent conditions and conditional radius/error bounds; native remainder and units require independent evidence.
finite-radius.reopen: Rank persistence, bounded noise gain and independently bounded remainder on a declared DPT neighborhood.

command-algebra.derivation: Finite future-word congruence and original-expression inverse definedness are independently checked; theorem families motivate the audit.
command-algebra.ceiling: Explicit finite model / supplied samples; no continuous-domain or exact-algebra promotion.
command-algebra.reopen: A rival history separated by a future word or stage event, or rational intermediate-map failure.

mixed-interaction.derivation: Four-corner contrast/(ab) is the rectangle-average mixed derivative. Center error<= (Ma|a|+Mb|b|)/2 + sum(eta)/|ab|. One query has a cubic null family.
mixed-interaction.ceiling: Conditional scalar interval, given matched anchors, valid rectangle and external error/variation bounds.
mixed-interaction.reopen: Matched archived anchors and independently justified error envelopes, or a prospective query separating the cubic rival.

stability.derivation: Dimension, error, gain and class scope are separate. Finite-bank Lipschitz gain screens for collisions but is not a whole-class extension proof.
stability.reopen: A whole-class factor, finite-radius gain envelope, or stage-transition counterexample becomes available.

acquisition.derivation: Deterministic post-processing cannot increase information relative to the complete original observation; lossy summaries may still be improved from stored raw traces.
acquisition.ceiling: Data-processing argument; probabilistic experiment-dominance statements require an explicit noise model.
acquisition.reopen: Candidate readout splits a goal-visible fiber left by the declared current observation.

information.derivation: Independent goal-packing code lower bound; Gaussian memory, automata and binary/deletion results retain their own model assumptions.
information.ceiling: Elementary packing with fixed goals/class; source-specific sharp bounds remain conditional.
information.reopen: Declared history/command class and a verified matching memory or channel model.

identifiability.derivation: Specify model class, goal and invisible symmetries; audit physical-to-auxiliary injectivity. Conservation is separate from uniqueness.
identifiability.ceiling: Method transfer; source PDE uniqueness/nonuniqueness does not establish DPT uniqueness.
identifiability.reopen: Changed DPT model class, symmetry, regularity or auxiliary reduction.

certificate.derivation: Separate center/tangent/Gram/remainder/readout/provenance and leave unresolved computational cells unresolved.
certificate.ceiling: Certificate architecture only; selected MUB statement is weaker than the headline.
certificate.reopen: A load-bearing DPT numerical claim needs an independently checkable margin.

operator-envelope.derivation: Compare numerical-range envelope with classical energy/logarithmic-norm bound on the same fixed operator and readout.
operator-envelope.ceiling: Watch until a native fixed operator and polynomial/rational readout are declared.
operator-envelope.reopen: Frozen nonnormal propagator and readout for which the source theorem yields a tighter executable bound.

watch_scope: Relevant paper directories (PDF/README/TeX/bibliography), selected scope docs including currently absent docs, comparator declarations/configs, solution entry modules and toolchain. Full Lean imports are pinned by source commit; this reading bundle does not independently verify the full proof library. CONTENTS.md/history.md are a separate discovery pass for moved/new/withdrawn sources.
lean_dependency_policy: Keep full Lean proofs/imports in canonical lean/. Read copied scope and comparator statements first; any proof-level reuse requires following the solution module and its imports at source_commit and running the canonical comparator setup. Imported-library edits alone do not reopen independently proved DPT lemmas.
